newsitem.title: USA: TIG Holdings Q1 net profit vs loss.
newsitem.headline: TIG Holdings Q1 net profit vs loss.

text.p: and investment gains, net of tax 36 34

NOTE: Net income included realized after-tax net investment gains of $0.5 million, or $0.01 per common share, in the first quarter of 1997 as compared with realized after-tax net investment gains of $0.1 million, or nil per common share, in the 1996 first quarter.

Operating income, excluding net investment gains and the first quarter 1996 restructuring charge, was $35.9 million, or $0.62 per common share, compared with $34.4 million, or $0.55 per common share, in the first quarter of 1996.

Results in the 1997 first quarter were adversely impacted by pre-tax catastrophe losses of $2.6 million, or $0.03 per common share on an after-tax basis, compared with 1996 first quarter pre-tax catastrophe losses of $3.6 million, or $0.04 per common share on an after-tax basis.

During the first quarter of 1997 the company repurchased 1.4 million shares of its common stock at an average price of $35.09 per common share as part of its ongoing stock repurchase program. To date, the company has repurchased 12.1 million shares of its common stock which represents 18.9 percent of the common shares outstanding at the time of the program's inception in 1994.
